snapshot.name: Bharti Airtel Ltd
snapshot.about: Bharti Airtel Ltd is one of the world’s leading providers of telecommunication services with presence in 18 countries representing India, Sri Lanka, 14 countries in Africa. [1]

latest_quarter.source: screener quarterly table (standardised from exchange filing)
latest_quarter.headline: Revenue +17% YoY, EBITDA +18%, PAT +24%, margin 57.4% (+0.7pp YoY)

notes.text: Margins expanding: OPM 55% vs 49% avg of prior years
Profit outgrowing revenue: PAT CAGR 40% vs revenue 15% (3y)
5-yr cumulative CFO is 4.18× PAT (₹419,802 Cr vs ₹100,454 Cr)
5-yr free cash flow ₹242,514 Cr; negative in 0 of 5 years

business_mix.what_it_does: Bharti Airtel Limited is a telecommunications and digital services company that provides mobile, homes, digital TV, B2B enterprise solutions, data centers, and financial services across India and Africa.

segments.name: Mobile
segments.note: Provides mobile voice and data services, including 5G and postpaid/prepaid offerings.

segments.name: Homes
segments.note: Provides broadband and fixed-wireless access connectivity for households.

segments.name: Digital TV
segments.note: Offers DTH and IPTV entertainment services.

segments.name: Airtel Business
segments.note: Delivers enterprise connectivity, cloud, cybersecurity, IoT, and digital solutions.

segments.name: Africa Operations
segments.note: Provides telecom and mobile money services across multiple African countries.

narrative_vs_numbers.management_says: Radio capex is trending down and margins are holding steady or expanding.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_say: Operating profit margins improved from 53% in Sep 2024 to 57% by Sep 2025 and stayed there through Sep 2026.

promises.credibility: Management has maintained stable operating performance and consistent margin expansion, though most long-term capacity and revenue multiplier targets remain pending.

bull: ROCE is 17.6% and ROE is 20.3%, showing strong capital returns.
Latest quarter Sep 2026 revenue grew 17% YoY while PAT jumped 24%.
Debt to Equity dropped significantly to 1.26 down from 2.63 three periods ago.
bear: Guidance indicates EBITDA margins may trend slightly downwards over the longer term as the digital portfolio steps up.
Future data center portfolio capacity of one gigawatt is multi-year and the target has not yet elapsed.
Guidance check for 25% share in the overall Data Center market is pending as the target is set for 3 to 4 years out.
